name: Sunburst

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: 60-foot-radius flash of sunlight: Con save or 12d6 Radiant and Blinded for 1 minute; half damage only on a success.
text: Blinded creatures repeat the Constitution save at the end of each of their turns, ending the condition on a success. The flash also dispels magical Darkness in the area.
